sources.snippet: Spark-X2.6-4B delivers inference efficiency on par with or better than comparable on-device models, including Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-E4B. It combines this efficiency with stronger capabilities, making it a practical choice for responsive, resource-conscious on-device AI.
